senses.gloss:
गोमत् a.
1 Rich in cows.
--2
Possessing or containing cattle.
--3
Mixed with milk. --n. Possession
of cattle, property consisting in
herds.
--ती N. of a river.

गोमय a.
1 Consisting of cattle.
--2 Defiled with cow-dung.
--यः, --यं
Cow-dung.
--यं Cowdung cake;
उपलशकलमेतद्भेदकं गोमयानां Mu. 3. 15.
--Comp.
--उत्था {1} a kind of beetle
found in cow-dung {2} a gad fly.
--छत्रं, --प्रियं a mushroom, a fungus.

गोमिन् a. Rich in herds. --m.
1
An owner of cattle.
--2 A jackal.
--3
A worshipper.
--4 An attendant on
a Buddha.
